versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 introduces a comprehensive lead-generation (CRO/conversion-funnel) audit and optimization assistant for websites.

- Added structured workflow for analyzing websites’ conversion funnels and lead forms, producing health checks, prioritized suggestions, and risk-graded action plans.
- Integrates a zero-dependency Python audit script to evaluate site pages and forms, delivering a detailed, structured report.
- Offers 5 prioritized optimization points per audit, clearly categorizing each by risk (low or high).
- Enables low-risk optimizations to be applied directly through CMS MCP tools after user consent and credential validation; high-risk actions require additional confirmation.
- Includes strict editing safeguards: preserves site template logic, form behaviors, and only alters lead-gen–related fields or content.
- Supports both read-only analysis (any website) and actionable write-backs (with MCP credentials). Outputs code snippets/checklists if credentialed write-back isn’t possible.
